info.name: Composio Platform Account Management Tools API

params.name: toolkit_slug
params.description: The slug of the toolkit to filter by

params.name: tool_slugs
params.description: Comma-separated list of specific tool slugs to retrieve (overrides other filters)

params.name: auth_config_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of auth config IDs to filter tools by

params.name: important
params.description: Filter to only show important/featured tools (set to "true" to enable)

params.name: tags
params.description: Filter tools by one or more tags (can be specified multiple times)

params.name: scopes
params.description: Array of scopes to filter tools by)

params.name: query
params.description: Full-text search query to filter tools by name, slug, or description. Applied as a soft filter on top of other filters.

params.name: search
params.description: Deprecated: use "query" instead. Free-text search query to find tools by name, description, or functionality.

params.name: include_deprecated
params.description: Include deprecated tools in the response

params.name: toolkit_versions
params.description: Toolkit version specification. Use "latest" for latest versions or bracket notation for specific versions per toolkit.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of items per page, max allowed is 1000

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for pagination. The cursor is a base64 encoded string of the page and limit. The page is the page number and the limit is the number of items per page. The cursor is used to paginate through the items. The cursor is not required for the first page.

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of available tools with comprehensive filtering, sorting and search capabilities. Use query parameters to narrow down results by toolkit, tags, or search terms.

Retrieve a list of all available tool enumeration values (tool slugs) from latest version of each toolkit. This endpoint returns a comma-separated string of tool slugs that can be used in other API calls.

params.name: tool_slug
params.description: The unique slug identifier of the tool

params.name: version
params.description: Optional version of the tool to retrieve

params.name: toolkit_versions
params.description: Toolkit version specification. Use "latest" for latest versions or bracket notation for specific versions per toolkit.

items.docs: Retrieve detailed information about a specific tool using its slug identifier. This endpoint returns full metadata about a tool including input/output parameters, versions, and toolkit information.

params.name: tool_slug
params.description: The tool slug to execute

items.docs: Execute a specific tool operation with provided arguments and authentication. This is the primary endpoint for integrating with third-party services and executing tools. You can provide structured arguments or use natural language processing by providing a text description of what you want to accomplish.

info.name: Generate tool inputs from natural language

params.name: tool_slug
params.description: The tool slug to generate inputs for

items.docs: Uses AI to translate a natural language description into structured arguments for a specific tool. This endpoint is useful when you want to let users describe what they want to do in plain language instead of providing structured parameters.
Proxy an HTTP request to a third-party API using connected account credentials. This endpoint allows making authenticated API calls to external services while abstracting away authentication details.

params.name: toolkit
params.description: Filter tools by toolkit name.

params.name: search
params.description: Search query to filter tools.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of tools to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset for pagination.

items.docs: Returns a list of available tools, optionally filtered by toolkit or search query.

params.name: toolId
params.description: The unique identifier of the tool to execute.

items.docs: Executes a specific tool action on behalf of a connected user.
